description: Create a comprehensive, enhanced MPS_Flexi_Product.html file that replaces the existing one. The new file must be a single self-contained HTML file with all CSS and JS inline. It must have rich content about all 3 plans, a comprehensive calculator with USD option, password-protected commission tab, and WhatsApp link on all pages.
steps: Replace /projects/sandbox/MPS-Flexi/MPS_Flexi_Product.html with a completely new, comprehensive version that includes all required features.

STRUCTURE: The HTML file must have these tabs: (1) Ringkasan Produk, (2) Plan A - Amanah, (3) Plan B - Berkah, (4) Plan C - Cermat, (5) Perbandingan Plan, (6) Tabel Premi, (7) Kalkulator, (8) Komisi (password-locked), (9) Materi Training, (10) FAQ / Tanya Jawab.
WHATSAPP BANNER: Sticky banner at top of page with 'PETRUS JAKUB MANULIFE 087781896087' linking to https://wa.me/6287781896087. Also add a footer WhatsApp CTA in EVERY tab content section.

TAB 1 - RINGKASAN PRODUK: Comprehensive overview including: what is MPS Flexi (Manulife Protection Solution Flexi), product type (traditional life insurance, non unit-link), 3 plan comparison cards (A=Amanah/Syariah/YRT, B=Berkah/Syariah/Level/15yr, C=Cermat/Konvensional/Limited Pay 5yr/15yr coverage), general terms (min UP 100jt, annual payment, IDR currency, 2yr waiting period, 14 day free look), visual icons/emojis to make content friendly for laypeople.

TAB 2 - PLAN A AMANAH: Full details including: Syariah basis (Tabarru + Wakalah bil Ujrah), YRT (Yearly Renewable Term) - premium increases yearly, entry age 18-60, coverage until age 65, min UP 100jt, annual payment, benefits (100% UP on death, 100% UP on accidental death), advantages (cheapest premium, max protection, no medical renewal), example illustrations for multiple ages/genders, explain in simple terms what YRT means and who it suits best.

TAB 3 - PLAN B BERKAH: Full details including: Syariah basis, level premium 15 years, entry age 18-55, coverage 15 years, payment period 15 years, min UP 100jt, benefits (100% UP on death, return of ALL contributions at end of 15 years if alive), advantages (fixed premium, savings + protection, Syariah compliant), example illustrations, explain in simple terms who it suits best.

TAB 4 - PLAN C CERMAT: Full details including: Conventional basis, limited pay 5 years, coverage 15 years, entry age 18-55, min UP 100jt, benefits (100% UP on death, return of ALL premiums at year 15 if alive), advantages (pay only 5 years, protected 15 years, 10 years premium-free, get money back), example illustrations, explain in simple terms who it suits best.

TAB 5 - PERBANDINGAN PLAN: Side-by-side comparison table of all 3 plans covering: basis (syariah/konvensional), premium type, entry age, coverage period, payment period, min UP, benefits, return of premium, ideal customer profile. Use color-coded cards.

TAB 6 - TABEL PREMI: Complete premium tables for all 3 plans. Plan A: ages 18-60 for Pria and Wanita per UP 100jt (use data from existing HTML - interpolated rates). Plan B: ages 18-55 for Pria and Wanita per UP 100jt. Plan C: ages 18-55 for Pria and Wanita per UP 100jt. Include note that rates scale linearly with UP amount.

TAB 7 - KALKULATOR: This is the most critical tab. Must include dropdown selectors for: (a) Plan (A/B/C), (b) Gender (Pria/Wanita), (c) Age (full range appropriate for selected plan), (d) Uang Santunan/UP (100jt, 250jt, 500jt, 750jt, 1M, 1.5M, 2M, 3M, 5M), (e) Mata Uang (IDR/USD with exchange rate 16,000), (f) Masa Bayar (auto-set based on plan: YRT for A, 15th for B, 5th for C), (g) Masa Perlindungan (auto-set: s.d. 65 for A, 15th for B, 15th for C). The calculator must: show result immediately on any change, display annual premium in selected currency, for Plan B show total 15yr payment and return amount, for Plan C show total 5yr payment and return amount, show monthly equivalent (annual/12), use interpolation formula for ages between known data points, show disclaimer that this is an estimate. Use the premium rate data from the existing HTML file (base rates anchored at age 40 male UP 1B: Plan A=4jt, Plan B=22jt, Plan C=140jt). Female discount approximately 80% for A, 85% for B and C.

TAB 8 - KOMISI: Must be PASSWORD-PROTECTED with password '123'. On tab click, show a prompt/modal asking for password. If correct, show commission structure. If wrong, show error and don't reveal content. Commission data: Plan A (YRT): Year 1 = 25%, Year 2+ = 5%. Plan B (15th): Year 1 = 30%, Year 2 = 10%, Year 3-5 = 5%, Year 6+ = 2%. Plan C (5th): Year 1 = 20%, Year 2 = 7.5%, Year 3-5 = 5%. Also include bonus info (persistency bonus, contest/trip rewards, overriding for leaders). Embed the commission image (Komisi MPS Flexi.jpg) as base64 data URI - read the file and convert to base64.

TAB 9 - MATERI TRAINING: Comprehensive training material including: product knowledge (what is MPS, 3 variants), selling points per plan, target market per plan, handling objections (with specific rebuttals for common objections like 'mahal', 'sudah ada BPJS', 'uang hilang', 'belum perlu', 'nanti saja'), application process (SPAJ, documents needed, medical checkup thresholds, payment, policy issuance timeline, free look period), claim procedures and requirements, do's and don'ts for agents.

TAB 10 - FAQ: Common questions and answers in simple Indonesian for laypeople. Cover: what is asuransi jiwa, difference syariah vs konvensional, what happens if I die, what happens if I live to end of term, can I cancel, what if I miss a payment, is my money safe, how to claim, how long does claim take, etc.

DESIGN: Use Manulife green (#00a758, #006838) color scheme. Modern card-based layout. Responsive design (mobile-friendly). Use simple Indonesian language throughout. Add helpful icons/emoji where appropriate to make content visually engaging. Use highlight boxes for important notes. Clean typography.

TECHNICAL: All CSS must be inline in <style> tag. All JS must be inline in <script> tag. No external dependencies (no CDN, no external fonts). The file must be completely self-contained. Use standard web-safe fonts (Segoe UI, Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif).

For the commission image embedding: use Python to read '/projects/sandbox/MPS-Flexi/Komisi MPS Flexi.jpg', convert to base64, and embed as data:image/jpeg;base64,... in an tag within the Komisi tab (only visible after password entry).
